items.title_en: Patrick Stewart has died
items.title_zh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特去世
items.summary_en: Patrick Stewart, beloved for Star Trek's Captain Picard and a long career in theatre and film, has died. His work helped redefine leadership in science fiction and mentored generations of actors. The news prompts reflection on a prolific career that bridged stage, screen, and iconic franchises.
items.summary_zh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特因病去世，曾因星际迷航中帕克船长等角色而家喻户晓。其横跨舞台、电视和电影的职业生涯对科幻与表演行业产生深远影响。人们由此缅怀这位多产演员及其对文化的贡献。

items.title_en: Binance-hacker-1029 – $5.6B stolen from Binance
items.title_zh: Binance 黑客案1029：从币安被盗5.6亿美元
items.summary_en: A $5.6B theft linked to Binance highlights the ongoing scale of crypto-exchange breaches. On-chain tracing attempts to map the stolen funds as they move through wallets and mixers, showing how investigators pursue assets long after a hack. The lesson for builders is to strengthen custody security (multi-sig, cold storage) and incident response readiness.
items.summary_zh: 涉及币安的巨额盗窃案，金额约56亿美元，凸显集中交易所安全风险。链上追踪尝试绘出赃款去向，显示即便多年后仍有追踪的可能。对系统设计者的启示是加强资产托管安全（多签、冷存储）与快速事件响应能力。

items.title_en: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
items.title_zh: 发布 Mistral Large 4 的权重
items.summary_en: Mistral AI has released the weights for Mistral Large 4, enabling researchers to run and fine-tune the model locally. This move reduces reliance on hosted APIs and accelerates experimentation, but also brings licensing, safety, and governance considerations to the fore in open-weight AI projects.
items.summary_zh: Mistral Large 4 的权重已对外公开，研究者和开发者可以在本地部署与微调。此举降低对 API 的依赖，促进实验，但也引发许可、安全与治理方面的讨论。

items.title_en: We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry
items.title_zh: 在 Minecraft 与 Mindustry 中测试 AI 代理群
items.summary_en: Researchers ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry to study emergent coordination at scale. The experiments illustrate how simple agents, when put in shared environments, can exhibit complex group behaviors, informing the design of scalable multi-agent systems and game AI safety. The work provides hands-on demos for researchers building autonomous agents in synthetic worlds.
items.summary_zh: 在 Minecraft 与 Mindustry 中测试AI代理群，研究群体协作与尺度效应。实验表明，简单代理在共享环境中可涌现出复杂的协同行为，为多智能体系统和游戏AI安全提供直观范例。

items.title_en: Google Search is now less than half of Alphabet’s revenue
items.title_zh: 谷歌搜索营收占比跌破一半，成 Alphabet 新挑战
items.summary_en: Alphabet's core search business now accounts for less than half of its revenue, underscoring a broader shift toward cloud, YouTube, and other bets. The trend highlights how platform diversification affects investor sentiment and strategic priorities for large tech companies.
items.summary_zh: Alphabet 的核心搜索业务如今贡献不足一半的营收，显示云计算、YouTube 等新领域的增长分担作用日益增大。此趋势影响投资者情绪与大型科技公司未来的战略重点。

items.title_en: Alleged Chinese spy had 'close relationship' with Nvidia boss Jensen Huang
items.title_zh: 疑似中国间谍与黄仁勋关系密切
items.summary_en: An alleged Chinese intelligence asset is reported to have forged a close relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, fueling concerns about insider risk and IP protection in the AI hardware race. The episode underscores how executive networks can become vectors for state-linked influence, pushing firms to tighten access controls and disclosures around partnerships. For technologists, it's a reminder to guard sensitive collaborations and monitor for unusual access patterns.
items.summary_zh: 一份报道声称一名中国情报人员与 Nvidia 创始人黄仁勋关系密切，引发对内部人风险和知识产权保护的担忧。此事揭示高层网络可能成为国家利益争夺的渠道，促使企业加强访问控制与合作披露。对技术公司而言，需谨慎管理敏感合作与异常访问。

items.title_en: H.264 Is Magic (2016)
items.summary_en: H.264 Is Magic (2016) analyzes why the H.264 video codec became a de-facto standard, enabling efficient compression, broad hardware support, and widespread adoption. It discusses licensing realities that helped lock in the standard and powered decades of streaming and video apps.
items.summary_zh: H.264 的魔力（2016）解析为何 H.264 成为事实标准、实现高效压缩与广泛的硬件支持。文章还讨论了授权环境如何将该标准锁定并推动多年来的流媒体与视频应用发展。

items.title_en: A tiny world model running games on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W
items.title_zh: 在 Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W 上运行的微型世界模型
items.summary_en: A tiny world model runs on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, showing that edge AI is creeping into microcontrollers. The demo demonstrates memory-efficient planning and small neural models that fit in ultra‑compact hardware, hinting at future autonomous nodes in IoT. It signals potential for smarter, low-power devices at the edge.
items.summary_zh: 在 Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W 上跑出一个极小的世界模型，展示边缘AI在微控制器上的潜力。该演示表明在资源受限设备上也能运行简短的神经模型和规划任务。预示着物联网边缘设备将拥有更智能的能力。

items.title_en: LLM Voice
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型的语音交互
items.summary_en: LLM Voice examines how language models function in voice-based interfaces, separate from text prompts, emphasizing the need to address speech recognition, latency, and user expectations. It argues for treating voice as a distinct modality with tailored UX and safety considerations.
items.summary_zh: LLM 在语音场景中的交互方式需要和文本输入不同的设计原则。本文强调处理语音识别、延迟和用户预期的重要性，并提出面向语音的 UX 和安全性设计要点。

items.title_en: ‘You Are Done’: The letter sent to King by the F.B.I (2014)
items.title_zh: 你完了：FBI 致马丁·路德·金的信（2014）
items.summary_en: The uncensored FBI letter to Martin Luther King Jr. from the 1960s reveals coercive surveillance tactics and personal pressure used to undermine civil rights leadership. The document provides a stark view of how state power interacted with dissent, and its release invites renewed scrutiny of civil liberties in government overreach.
items.summary_zh: 这封未删改的 FBI 信件揭示了上世纪60年代对马丁·路德·金的监控与施压。信件展示了政府权力如何试图压制民权领袖的声音，引发对公民自由与政府越权行为的再关注。

items.title_en: El Niño Is Flooding California's Coasts with the Highest Tides to Come
items.title_zh: 厄尔尼诺正在以将至的最高涨潮冲击加州海岸
items.summary_en: El Niño is driving record-high tides along California’s coast, foreshadowing a winter of coastal flooding and erosion. The hotter Pacific and rising sea levels amplify the risk to infrastructure, beaches, and water systems. This underlines how climate variability is reshaping regional risk management.
items.summary_zh: 厄尔尼诺正在推动加州海岸的记录性涨潮，预示着今冬可能出现海岸洪水与侵蚀。更热的太平洋气候和上升的海平面放大了对基础设施、海滩和水资源系统的风险。这凸显了气候变率正在重塑区域风险管理的现实。

items.title_en: Proton goes all in on using AI
items.title_zh: Proton 全力拥抱人工智能
items.summary_en: Proton is embracing AI across its services, signaling a broader push to integrate intelligent features while maintaining privacy standards. The move suggests a balance between AI-powered productivity and privacy protections, including on-device processing and user consent controls.
items.summary_zh: Proton 正在将 AI 融入其服务之中，强调在保护隐私前提下提供智能功能的能力。此举折射出在提升生产力的同时，如何通过本地化处理与用户控制来平衡隐私保护与 AI 便利性。

items.title_en: DoorDash to acquire Instacart
items.title_zh: DoorDash 将收购 Instacart
items.summary_en: DoorDash announced plans to acquire Instacart, creating a larger player in on-demand grocery delivery. The merger could reshape competition, pricing, and last-mile logistics, while triggering antitrust scrutiny and integration challenges for both platforms.
items.summary_zh: DoorDash 宣布收购 Instacart，将打造更强的即时送货生态。合并可能改变市场竞争格局、定价与末端配送效率，同时面临潜在的反垄断审查和整合挑战。

items.title_en: I went to Mexico to test-drive the cars Americans can’t buy
items.title_zh: 我去墨西哥试驾美国买不到的汽车
items.summary_en: A road trip in Mexico is used to sample cars not sold in the US market, shedding light on cross-border pricing, regional regulations, and the evolving landscape of climate-focused transportation. The piece captures how geography shapes consumer access to technology.
items.summary_zh: 通过在墨西哥试驾美国买不到的车型，揭示跨境定价、区域法规以及低碳交通工具的区域差异。文章讲述地理因素如何影响科技产品在不同市场的获取。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon is the new #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 成为人工分析智能指数 v5 的新冠军
items.summary_en: Gemini 4 Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5, signaling strong performance on a suite of analytical benchmarks. The result helps buyers and researchers gauge which models excel at reasoning and data interpretation as AI evaluation matures.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 在人工分析智能指数 v5 中位居第一，表明其在一组分析基准上的出色表现。该结果为购买方和研究者提供了评估推理与数据解释能力的参考，体现 AI 评估体系的演进。

items.title_en: Why is this fingerprinting script creating bioweapons?
items.title_zh: 为什么这个指纹脚本会创建生物武器？
items.summary_en: The piece spotlights dual‑use risks in code that touches biology, illustrating how seemingly harmless fingerprinting tools can be repurposed for harmful outcomes. It argues for stronger safety reviews, access controls, and governance around bio‑related automation to curb misuse.
items.summary_zh: 该文聚焦于触及生物领域的代码的双重用途风险，展示了看似无害的指纹脚本如何被误用来制造生物威胁。强调需要加强安全审查、访问控制和对生物相关自动化的治理，以防止滥用。

items.title_en: Tomáš Mikolov awarded the Medal of Merit by the President of the Czech Republic
items.title_zh: 捷克总统授予托马斯·米科洛夫勋章
items.summary_en: The Czech Republic honors Tomáš Mikolov for his foundational contributions to word embeddings and neural language processing. The award underscores the impact of his work on modern NLP and the broader European AI ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 捷克共和国为词嵌入与神经语言处理领域的奠基性贡献者托马什·米科洛夫颁发勋章，体现其对现代 NLP 和欧洲 AI 生态的影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Auto Dismiss Mac OS "Allow <app> to find devices on local networks?"
items.title_zh: Show HN：自动拒绝 MacOS 提示“允许应用发现本地网络设备？”
items.summary_en: Auto Dismiss Mac OS 'Allow app to find devices on local networks?' is a small open-source tool that automatically closes that permission prompt. It highlights the tension between a smooth UX and strict local-network permissions, inviting a discussion on safety vs convenience. The project serves as a reminder of how permission prompts influence everyday security decisions.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目自动拒绝 macOS 的“允许应用发现本地网络设备？”提示，提升了使用体验。产品背后的讨论聚焦于 UX 与本地网络权限之间的权衡，以及安全治理的重要性。

items.title_en: The importance of communities around software
items.title_zh: 软件背后社区的重要性
items.summary_en: A discussion on how communities around software underpin sustainability, contribution, and governance; effective communities accelerate adoption and help sustain projects beyond core maintainers. 2-3 sentences on how to foster healthy communities.
items.summary_zh: 围绕软件的社区对可持续性、贡献与治理至关重要。活跃的社区能提升采用率并帮助项目走得更远，作者也分享培育健康社区的要点。

items.title_en: A Pig, the State, and War: Porco Rosso (Kurenai No Buta) (2014)
items.title_zh: 猪、国家与战争：2014年的《红猪》研究
items.summary_en: A scholarly reading of Porco Rosso examines how a pig pilot doubles as a critique of war, fascism, and propaganda within a whimsical, airborne world. The piece places the film in Studio Ghibli’s anti-war tradition and uses its satirical tone to illuminate questions about heroism and nationalism. It offers fresh framing for understanding the film’s political subtext.
items.summary_zh: 对《红猪》的学术解读探讨了猪头驾驶员如何成为对战争、法西斯主义与宣传的批判载体，在一个充满想象的空中世界中呈现。论文将影片置于吉卜力工作室的反战传统之中，利用讽刺语气揭示英雄主义与民族主义间的张力。为理解影片的政治潜台词提供了新的视角。

items.title_en: Patrick Stewart Has Died
items.title_zh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特去世
items.summary_en: Patrick Stewart, the iconic actor known for his Star Trek captain and stage work, has died. His career spanned theater, film, and television, shaping pop culture across decades. His legacy includes leadership in science fiction media and mentorship of performers worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特这位因科幻角色和舞台表演而闻名的演员去世，职业生涯跨越舞台、电视和电影，对文化影响深远。

items.title_en: The Great American Rascal: Tom Sawyer at 150
items.title_zh: 美国伟大顽童：汤姆·索亚150周年
items.summary_en: On its 150th anniversary, Tom Sawyer is re-examined as a cornerstone of American literature and cultural myth. The piece traces Twain’s mischievous boy as a vehicle for debates about childhood freedom, social norms, and American identity, and surveys his lasting influence on readers and media.
items.summary_zh: 在汤姆·索亚诞辰150周年之际，该作被重新解读为美国文学与文化神话的重要基石。文章追溯马克·吐温笔下这个顽皮男孩如何推动关于童年自由、社会规范与美国身份的讨论，并考察他对后世文学与大众文化的持续影响。

items.title_en: StackOverflow now gets fewer than 1000 questions a month
items.title_zh: Stack Overflow 现每月不到 1000 条问题
items.summary_en: Stack Overflow now reports fewer than 1,000 questions per month, a dramatic drop that signals a major shift in how developers seek help online. The decline could reflect migration to other communities, changes in data collection, or platform strategy.
items.summary_zh: Stack Overflow 现每月提问不足一千条，显示开发者在线求助方式的显著转变。下降可能源于迁移到其他社区、数据收集变化或平台策略调整。

items.title_en: Hackers expose the identities of more than 40k DHS employees
items.title_zh: 黑客披露超过 4 万 DHS 员工身份信息
items.summary_en: Hackers exposed the identities of more than 40,000 DHS employees, raising concerns about public exposure of government personnel data. The breach underscores the need for improved data hygiene, phishing defenses, and tighter access controls.
items.summary_zh: 黑客披露超过 4 万名国土安全部员工身份信息，暴露政府人员数据的公开风险。该事件凸显需要加强数据清理、抵御钓鱼攻击能力以及更严格的访问控制。

items.title_en: ElementaryUI – Swift, in the Browser
items.title_zh: ElementaryUI：在浏览器中使用 Swift
items.summary_en: A browser-based Swift UI library or runtime enabling Swift in the browser; discuss implications for developer experience, performance, and WebAssembly-like solutions, enabling Swift developers to write front-end. 2-3 sentences.
items.summary_zh: ElementaryUI 将 Swift 带入浏览器端，提供在前端使用 Swift 的能力。该项目可能影响前端开发者体验、跨平台开发，以及对现有 JS/TS 生态的挑战。

items.title_en: Qwenputer: A functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
items.title_zh: Qwenputer：在 Qwen3.5 内实现的确定性 RISC-V CPU
items.summary_en: Qwenputer reveals a functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU embedded inside Qwen3.5. The project demonstrates hardware-level determinism within a language-model environment, hinting at reproducible compute and new sandboxing possibilities for AI systems.
items.summary_zh: Qwenputer 展示了一个在 Qwen3.5 内部实现的可运行且确定性的 RISC-V CPU。此举表明可以在语言模型环境中进行硬件级别的确定性仿真，为可重复计算和 AI 系统的安全沙箱打开新可能。

items.title_en: Chained PHP2Shell exploit roots 25 servers, including US Government servers
items.title_zh: PHP2Shell 链式利用入侵 25 台服务器，其中包括政府服务器
items.summary_en: A chained PHP2Shell exploit compromised 25 servers, including government systems, demonstrating how multiple vulnerabilities can be stitched together to achieve full control. The post stresses defense-in-depth and timely patching across sectors.
items.summary_zh: 通过一系列漏洞拼接出的 PHP2Shell 链式利用侵入了 25 台服务器，其中还包括政府系统。该报告强调要在各层确保防御深度并及时打补丁以防止横向扩散。

items.title_en: If IPv4 were land
items.title_zh: 若把 IPv4 当成陆地
items.summary_en: IPv4 scarcity is depicted as a shrinking landmass with a fixed coastline of addresses. The piece explains why NATs and address transfers matter, and why IPv6 adoption remains essential for scalable growth. It highlights practical implications for network architects and service providers.
items.summary_zh: 将 IPv4 的稀缺性比作逐渐缩小的陆地，地址空间如同海岸线般有限。文章阐述网络地址转换和地址交易的重要性，以及为什么长期推进 IPv6 对实现可扩展性至关重要，并讨论对网络架构师与服务提供商的实际影响。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon：谷歌推出的 Gemini 系列新一代模型
items.summary_en: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google's latest in the Gemini family, focusing on efficiency and safety with improved inference and reliability for enterprise apps. It demonstrates ongoing progress in AI model scaling, with Carbon as a more efficient variant for dense workloads.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 作为谷歌 Gemini 系列的新一代模型，强调在企业应用中的推理效率与安全性提升。该系列继续推动大模型规模化，Carbon 版本在高密度任务中更具效率。

items.title_en: The US added a record 20.2 GWh of battery storage in just 3 months
items.title_zh: 美国三个月新增创纪录的 20.2 GWh 电池储能
items.summary_en: The US added a record 20.2 GWh of grid-scale battery storage in three months, signaling rapid growth in storage deployments to support more renewables. This surge reflects policy momentum and project pipelines, while underscoring ongoing challenges like permitting. Expanded storage improves grid reliability and price resilience.
items.summary_zh: 美国在三个月内新增创纪录的 20.2 GWh 电网级储能，显示出对可再生能源的更大支撑力。此波增长反映了政策推动与项目渠道的积压，同时也暴露出许可等持续挑战。扩大储能容量将提升电网可靠性与价格韧性。

items.title_en: Claude Duet is the first personal-assistant-type harness that feels useful
items.title_zh: Claude Duet 是第一款有用的个人助手型 harness
items.summary_en: Claude Duet presents a personal-assistant-style harness that feels genuinely useful, enabling two AI assistants to collaborate on tasks with shared context. The approach demonstrates how orchestrating specialized agents can improve productivity and reduce friction for users. It points toward more practical, assistant-as-a-service tooling.
items.summary_zh: Claude Duet 提供了一种“个人助理式”协调框架，使两位 AI 助手协作完成任务，用户感受上更有用。该方法展示多代理协作能降低操作摩擦、提升生产力。

items.title_en: How Google determines the names for bodies of water in Google Earth (2008)
items.title_zh: Google 如何为地球水体命名（2008 年）
items.summary_en: Google Earth's naming process for bodies of water in 2008 relied on official gazetteers and editorial review, balancing accuracy with user contributions. The policy reveals how large platforms manage geographic naming and data provenance.
items.summary_zh: 2008 年 Google Earth 在水体命名中结合官方名录与编辑审核，平衡准确性与用户贡献。该政策揭示大型平台如何管理地名与数据来源的取舍与管控。

items.title_en: Zombie stats: Where the numbers AI quotes come from
items.title_zh: 僵尸数据：AI 引用的数字来自哪里
items.summary_en: A deep dive into the provenance of statistics AI quotes, exposing how numbers can be misattributed, outdated, or misleading. The piece argues for rigorous data provenance and better tooling to audit AI-generated claims.
items.summary_zh: 深入分析 AI 所引用统计数据的来源，揭示数字可能被错引、过时或误导。呼吁加强数据溯源和工具，提升 AI 生成信息的可信度。

items.title_en: Grace Blackwell needs a new scheduler: 27% more usable GPUs from the same racks
items.title_zh: Grace Blackwell 需要一个新的调度器：在相同机架上挖掘 27% 的 GPU 可用性
items.summary_en: A scheduler redesign dramatically improves GPU utilization for multi-tenant AI workloads, squeezing 27% more usable GPUs from the same rack.
items.summary_zh: 调度器的改进带来多租户 AI 工作负载下显著的 GPU 利用率提升，在不增硬件的前提下从同一机架挤出约 27% 的可用 GPU。文章分析了打包、隔离和调度策略等设计要点，以及对系统 throughput 的影响。

items.title_en: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
items.title_zh: 苹果的 Git 仍信任被妥协的 eMudhra 证书
items.summary_en: Apple's git still trusts compromised eMudhra certificates, leaving room for potential man-in-the-middle attacks on TLS and code signing trust. This highlights how supply chain security depends on up-to-date trust stores, and warrants prompt certificate revocation and rotation.
items.summary_zh: 苹果的 Git 仍信任被妥协的 eMudhra 证书，增加了 TLS 与代码签名信任被滥用的风险。这凸显供应链安全对最新信任存储的依赖，应尽快撤销并轮换相关证书。

items.title_en: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
items.title_zh: Claude Code 会定期将后台代理的对话记录发送给模型
items.summary_en: Claude Code transmits each background agent’s transcripts to its model, raising privacy and data-use concerns for developers. This telemetry behavior highlights how data sharing can impact confidentiality in code tools.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 会将后台代理的对话记录发送给模型，引发隐私与数据使用方面的担忧。此类遥测行为凸显了代码工具在数据共享方面的潜在风险。

items.title_en: Zero click, silent, remote Android DoS
items.title_zh: 零点击静默的远程 Android 拒绝服务攻击
items.summary_en: A zero-click, silent remote DoS vulnerability on Android enables denial-of-service without user interaction, potentially affecting many devices. Exploits could be triggered via crafted traffic or messages, highlighting the urgent need for timely OS patches and mitigations.
items.summary_zh: 一个无需用户交互、静默发生的 Android 远程拒绝服务漏洞，可能影响大量设备。利用方式可能通过特制网络流量或消息触发，凸显了及时打补丁与缓解措施的紧迫性。

items.title_en: After 28 years walking across the globe, he's almost home
items.title_zh: 环游全球28年后，他几乎回到家
items.summary_en: After nearly three decades of walking, Karl Bushby is nearing the end of his land-based circumnavigation, tackling remaining miles and bureaucratic hurdles. The feat underscores the perseverance and logistical challenges of long-running exploration, and highlights how cross-border routes complicate modern adventures.
items.summary_zh: 几乎三十年的行走旅程接近尾声，Karl Bushby 即将抵达家的门槛，同时还要应对剩余路途与繁琐的边界与许可问题。这一壮举凸显了持久探索的毅力以及跨境路线对现代冒险的挑战。

items.title_en: Sylphide OS: a general-purpose OS for microcontroller-based computers
items.title_zh: Sylphide OS：面向微控制器的通用操作系统
items.summary_en: Sylphide OS presents a general-purpose operating system designed for microcontroller-based computers, potentially bridging embedded devices with more traditional OS concepts. The project explores modularity, scheduling, and driver support to enable richer, more capable embedded applications.
items.summary_zh: Sylphide OS 为基于微控制器的计算机提供通用操作系统，试图将嵌入式设备与传统操作系统概念连接起来。该项目在模块化、调度和驱动支持方面探索，为更强大的嵌入式应用打开了新可能。

items.title_en: NetBSD adds a new text editor called atto
items.title_zh: NetBSD 推出面向初学者的文本编辑器 Atto
items.summary_en: NetBSD now includes Atto, a beginner-friendly text editor built into the system, aiming to lower the barrier to editing on BSD. It provides a simpler alternative to traditional editors like Vim or Nano, helping new users and admins configure systems more easily. This could encourage wider BSD adoption among newcomers.
items.summary_zh: NetBSD 基础系统新增 Atto，一款面向初学者的文本编辑器，降低在 BSD 上进行文本编辑的门槛。它提供比 Vim 或 Nano 更简化的编辑体验，帮助新手与管理员更轻松地修改配置、管理系统。这一举措或将提升新用户对 BSD 的接受度。

items.title_en: Utah charges Kalshi and its CEO with illegally promoting online gambling
items.title_zh: 犹他州对 Kalshi 的 CEO 等提起非法促销线上赌博指控
items.summary_en: Utah authorities charge Kalshi and its CEO with illegal online gambling promotion related to their prediction market platform, raising questions about regulatory compliance and platform risk for fintech startups.
items.summary_zh: 犹他州对 Kalshi 及其 CEO 提出非法促销线上赌博的指控，凸显对预测市场平台的监管合规挑战以及 fintech 初创公司的潜在风险。

items.title_en: 16colo.rs – ANSI/ASCII art archive
items.title_zh: 16colo.rs：ANSI/ASCII 艺术档案
items.summary_en: 16colo.rs preserves a vibrant subculture of ANSI/ASCII art, chronicling scenes from BBS and early internet days. The archive is a treasure trove for retro computing fans and a reminder of how terse text grew into a visual language.
items.summary_zh: 16colo.rs 收藏并展示了 ANSI/ASCII 艺术的丰富子文化，追忆 BBS 时代与早期互联网场景。这个档案是复古计算爱好者的宝库，也提醒人们文本如何演化为一种视觉语言。

items.title_en: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch
items.title_zh: 配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏和触控的 MacBook Pro
items.summary_en: Apple unveils a MacBook Pro featuring a new PROLED XDR display and touch input, promising vibrant color, high brightness, and responsive interaction. The move signals a push toward higher-end display tech and more interactive laptops.
items.summary_zh: 苹果推出搭载全新 PROLED XDR 显示屏与触控输入的 MacBook Pro，承诺带来更丰富的色彩、极高的亮度与灵敏的交互体验，标志着对高端显示技术与触控交互的进一步推进。

items.title_en: Forging a Microsoft Edge Full Chain with Logic Bugs Only
items.title_zh: 仅用逻辑漏洞打造 Edge 全链路利用
items.summary_en: A security researcher demonstrates a full exploit chain for Microsoft Edge using only logic bugs, not memory corruption, challenging assumptions about browser defenses.
items.summary_zh: 安全研究者展示如何仅靠逻辑漏洞就能构建 Edge 的完整利用链，未涉及内存损坏。这一结果挑战了对浏览器防护的部分假设，强调需加强威胁建模与持续的浏览器加固。

items.title_en: Ghostty 1.4
items.title_zh: Ghostty 1.4.0 版本发布
items.summary_en: Ghostty 1.4.0 marks an incremental release, bringing new features and bug fixes to the project.
items.summary_zh: Ghostty 1.4.0 标志着一次增量更新，带来新功能和错误修复。

items.title_en: Keplearn: Extract Equations from Data in Seconds
items.title_zh: Keplearn：秒级从数据中提取方程
items.summary_en: Keplearn is a tool that infers equations from data in seconds, enabling rapid symbolic modeling of complex systems. This accelerates scientific experimentation and can complement traditional regression with interpretable models.
items.summary_zh: Keplearn 能在秒级从数据中推断出方程，快速实现对复杂系统的符号建模。这加速了科学实验，并可与传统回归方法结合，产生可解释的模型。

items.title_en: IgE disruptor for food allergy with Claude-enabled antibody design [pdf]
items.title_zh: 基于 Claude 的抗体设计的 IgE 破坏剂研究
items.summary_en: A preprint describing an IgE disruptor designed with Claude-assisted antibody design, aiming to address food allergies. It demonstrates the growing role of AI in protein design and therapeutic development, while also highlighting the need for rigorous validation and safety studies. The work signals AI-accelerated biology, with risks and promise.
items.summary_zh: 一份预印本提出利用 Claude 启动的抗体设计来干扰食品过敏相关的 IgE 通路，具有潜在治疗意义。此类工作显示了 AI 辅助蛋白设计向实际治疗靠拢的趋势，但仍需大量实验验证。

items.title_en: What we know so far about Spain train crash
items.title_zh: 西班牙列车事故初步信息披露
items.summary_en: Early reporting on a high-profile Spain train crash outlines casualties, initial causes being investigated, and emergency response. Ongoing inquiries will determine safety implications for rail networks across Europe.
items.summary_zh: 对西班牙列车事故的初步报道显示伤亡情况与正在调查的初因，救援已在进行。后续调查结果将影响欧洲多国的铁路安全政策与运营实践。

items.title_en: CNC Stone Carving
items.title_zh: CNC 石材雕刻
items.summary_en: CNC stone carving blends automation with traditional craftsmanship, enabling precise, repeatable stonework for architecture and sculpture.
items.summary_zh: CNC 石材雕刻将自动化与传统工艺结合，实现建筑与雕塑领域的高精度、可重复加工。内容涵盖工作流、工具选型以及材料要点，以提升雕刻质量。

items.title_en: A Health Update
items.title_zh: 健康更新
items.summary_en: The author shares a health update, detailing current condition and what it means for upcoming work. They indicate possible temporary slowdowns in publishing while recovering.
items.summary_zh: 作者发布健康更新，详细说明当前状况及对未来工作的影响，并表示在康复期间发表节奏可能会暂时放慢。

items.title_en: Toxic experts (2017)
items.title_zh: 2017 年的有毒专家
items.summary_en: Toxic experts (2017) examines how certain expert communities can harbor counterproductive dynamics, offering lessons on governance, collaboration, and the psychology of expertise.
items.summary_zh: 2017 年的“有毒的专家”一文探讨了某些专家群体内部可能存在的破坏性动态，提出治理、协作与专业认知心理学的启示。

items.title_en: Archive Of Our Own down for maintenance for 2 to 4 weeks
items.title_zh: Archive Of Our Own 暂停维护，预计两到四周恢复
items.summary_en: Archive Of Our Own is down for maintenance for 2-4 weeks, affecting access for fans and creators. The disruption highlights the fragility and operational dependencies of large fan-fiction platforms.
items.summary_zh: AO3 正在进行为期两到四周的维护，用户和创作者的访问将受影响。这也凸显了大型同人平台在运营中的脆弱性与依赖性。

items.title_en: Emacs Turns 50
items.title_zh: Emacs迎来50周年
items.summary_en: Emacs turns 50, celebrating half a century of extensible, Lisp-based text editing that has influenced code editors and development workflows. Despite aging interfaces, its ecosystem endures through deep customization and a dedicated user base.
items.summary_zh: Emacs迎来50周年，庆祝这款基于 Lisp 的可扩展文本编辑器在代码编辑和开发工作流中的长期影响力。尽管界面相对陈旧，其通过深度定制和忠实用户群体仍保持生态活力。

items.title_en: Genie 4
items.title_zh: Genie 4：世界仿真的新一代
items.summary_en: Genie 4 from DeepMind represents a leap in world-simulation tech, enabling more realistic, scalable environments for AI training and planning. It aims to accelerate progress in robotics, game AI, and simulation-to-real transfer by providing richer, more controllable environments.
items.summary_zh: DeepMind 的 Genie 4 提供更真实、更可控的世界仿真能力，为 AI 训练和规划提供更丰富的环境，有望加速机器人、游戏 AI 以及从仿真到现实的迁移。

items.title_en: Kentucky man becomes the first humanist granted religious exemption from AI
items.title_zh: 肯塔基男子成首位获批就使用AI申请宗教豁免的人文主义者
items.summary_en: A Kentucky humanist obtained a religious exemption to use AI, marking a notable legal milestone in how religious beliefs intersect with workplace AI policies. The decision signals how courts and regulators may rethink AI usage rules in diverse belief systems.
items.summary_zh: 肯塔基一位人文主义者获得了使用 AI 的宗教豁免，这是宗教信仰与工作场所 AI 使用规则交叉的一个重要里程碑。此举可能推动对 AI 使用政策在不同信仰体系中的再考量。

items.title_en: We won't "just hang out"
items.title_zh: 我们不会只是闲逛
items.summary_en: The piece argues for purposeful collaboration and outcome-focused work rather than casual hanging out in tech teams.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张技术团队应以目标导向的协作取代单纯的闲聊。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Simantic (YC F26) – Firmware Simulation for AI Agents
items.title_zh: Simantic（YC F26）— 面向 AI 代理的固件仿真
items.summary_en: Simantic provides firmware-level simulation tooling to test AI agents in realistic hardware-like environments, enabling safer experimentation and faster iteration without physical prototypes. By integrating with existing agent runtimes, it helps developers reason about latency, memory, and real-world constraints.
items.summary_zh: Simantic 提供用于 AI 代理的固件级仿真工具，帮助在接近真实硬件的环境中进行安全测试和快速迭代，避免依赖实际硬件原型。通过与现有代理运行时集成，便于开发者评估延迟、内存与实世界约束。

items.title_en: Show HN: Overtone – Transcribe, correct and cut captions for any screen shape
items.title_zh: Show HN：Overtone — 适用于任意屏幕形状的字幕转写、纠错与裁剪
items.summary_en: Overtone is a show-n-HN project that transcribes, corrects, and cuts captions to fit any screen shape. It advances accessibility and localization workflows by automating caption adaptation. The tool can help creators reach diverse audiences across devices with fewer manual tweaks.
items.summary_zh: Overtone 是 Show HN 项目，能够转写、纠错并将字幕裁剪以适配任意屏幕形状，提升无障碍和本地化工作效率。它帮助内容创作者覆盖多设备场景，省去大量手动调整。

items.title_en: GitLab Security Incident: Attempted Exploitation of CVE-2026-97229
items.title_zh: GitLab 安全事件：尝试利用 CVE-2026-97229
items.summary_en: GitLab reports an attempted exploitation of CVE-2026-97229 as part of a security incident; patches have been released and admins are urged to upgrade. The incident underscores the ongoing pressure to patch quickly and audit dependencies in CI/CD platforms.
items.summary_zh: GitLab 报告了试图利用 CVE-2026-97229 的攻击行为，相关补丁已发布并敦促管理员尽快升级。此事件凸显在 CI/CD 平台上快速打补丁和审计依赖的持续压力。

items.title_en: Alphabet heads for a $500B drop in market value, biggest in its history
items.title_zh: Alphabet 市值或创历史性下跌 5,000 亿美元
items.summary_en: Reports suggest Alphabet could lose about $500 billion in market value, the largest such drop ever, as investors weigh growth in cloud, AI, and other bets against core ad revenue.
items.summary_zh: 报道称 Alphabet 的市值可能下跌约 5,000 亿美元，创历史最大幅度下滑；投资者在云、AI 等新业务与核心广告之间权衡，市场情绪也在推动大规模波动。

items.title_en: An Urgent Message on Artificial Intelligence from the Kogui People
items.title_zh: 科吉族对人工智能的紧急呼吁
items.summary_en: The Kogui people issue an urgent message about AI, urging ethical use, data sovereignty, and protection of indigenous knowledge. The statement calls on policymakers and technologists to center consent, cultural rights, and land stewardship in AI development.
items.summary_zh: 科吉族发出关于人工智能的紧急呼声，呼吁在 AI 应用中遵循伦理、数据主权与对本土知识的保护。声明敦促政策制定者与技术人员将同意权、文化权利与土地管理置于 AI 发展的核心。

items.title_en: Formlabs Studio 1 $699 Resin Printer
items.title_zh: Formlabs Studio 1：699美元树脂打印机
items.summary_en: Formlabs launches Studio 1, a $699 resin 3D printer aimed at hobbyists and education. It adds a low-cost entry point to Formlabs' lineup, potentially expanding access to high-resolution SLA prints.
items.summary_zh: Formlabs 推出 Studio 1，售价699美元的树脂3D打印机，面向爱好者与教育市场。此举为 Formlabs 的产品线带来更低的入门门槛，可能让高分辨率树脂打印更易于普及到工作室和课堂。

items.title_en: Git for the US Code
items.title_zh: 用 Git 管理美国法典
items.summary_en: Versioning the US Code with Git shows how large legal texts can be edited transparently and auditable over time. The piece weighs practical challenges—structure, numbering, and edition standards—and points to developer-style workflows (PRs, diffs) as a path to more collaborative lawmaking.
items.summary_zh: 用 Git 对美国法典进行版本控制展示了大型法文本如何实现可追溯、透明的编辑过程。文章评估了结构、编号和版本标准等实际挑战，并探讨了采用开发者工作流（合并请求、变更对比）以促进协作式修订的可能性。

items.title_en: Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments
items.title_zh: 日常工作：税务——在 50 项专业税务任务上评估 AI 代理
items.summary_en: Evaluates how AI agents perform across 50 real-world tax assignments, highlighting gaps in professional tax reasoning, document handling, and compliance checks. The findings matter for how automation reshapes knowledge work, raising questions about accuracy and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 对 AI 代理在 50 项真实税务任务中的表现进行评估，揭示专业税务推理、文档处理和合规检查方面的不足。结果影响自动化如何改变专业工作FLOW，并引发对准确性与问责制的讨论。

items.title_en: Cuba is skipping its November 1, 2026 clock change and staying on DST until 2027
items.title_zh: 古巴将继续使用夏令时，直至 2027 年
items.summary_en: Cuba has decided to skip the clock change on November 1, 2026 and will stay on DST through 2027, affecting scheduling and cross-border coordination with neighboring regions.
items.summary_zh: 古巴决定在 2026 年 11 月 1 日跳过时钟调整，夏令时将延续至 2027 年。这一决策将影响日常安排和与周边地区的跨境协作节奏。

items.title_en: Survival LLM: AI assistant and emergency library that runs on your own computer
items.title_zh: Survival LLM：可在本地运行的 AI 助手与应急知识库
items.summary_en: Survival LLM provides an AI assistant and an offline knowledge library that runs entirely on your own computer. This design emphasizes privacy, resilience, and disaster-scenario readiness, letting teams access critical information without cloud dependence.
items.summary_zh: Survival LLM 提供一个可在本地运行的 AI 助手和应急知识库，完全在本地计算机上运作。此设计强调隐私与韧性，支持在没有云端的情况下访问关键信息，提升灾害情景下的可用性。

items.title_en: AlpineBSD
items.title_zh: AlpineBSD
items.summary_en: AlpineBSD presents a BSD‑based distribution focused on security and simplicity in a compact footprint, aiming to bring BSD’s philosophy to users seeking streamlined, secure systems.
items.summary_zh: AlpineBSD 提供一个基于 BSD 的发行版，强调安全与简洁，体积小、适合追求高效与安全的用户。

items.title_en: US agency approves Amazon Leo’s $11.5B acquisition of Globalstar
items.title_zh: 美国机构批准亚马逊 Leo 115亿美元收购 Globalstar
items.summary_en: US regulators approve Amazon Leo's $11.5B acquisition of Globalstar, accelerating Amazon's satellite and IoT ambition. The deal could bolster global connectivity services, from backhaul to disaster resilience, while raising antitrust and spectrum-use questions.
items.summary_zh: 美国监管机构批准亚马逊 Leo 115 亿美元收购 Globalstar，加速了亚马逊在卫星与物联网领域的野心。交易可能提升全球连接能力，并引发反垄断与频谱使用方面的讨论。

items.title_en: The case of the 9 bit AES key
items.title_zh: 九位AES密钥之谜
items.summary_en: A blog post explores what happens if an AES key were only 9 bits long, showing how brutally small key space collapses brute-force resistance. It emphasizes why modern cryptography uses 128-bit, 192-bit, or 256-bit keys and how implementation constraints can inadvertently weaken security. The piece also serves as a cautionary tale about key management and API design.
items.summary_zh: 一篇博文探讨如果 AES 密钥只有 9 位会怎样，展示了极小的密钥空间将如何迅速削弱暴力破解的对抗性。文章强调现代密码学为何采用 128 位及更高位数的密钥，以及实现层面的约束如何无意中削弱安全性。该文也提醒在密钥管理与 API 设计中要避免此类风险。

items.title_en: Leak website releases data on DHS employees
items.title_zh: 泄漏网站公开数万名国土安全部雇员资料
items.summary_en: A leak site published tens of thousands of DHS employees' data, raising privacy and security concerns. The release could expose undercover workers and disrupt agency operations.
items.summary_zh: 一个泄漏网站公开数万名国土安全部员工的资料，带来隐私与安全方面的担忧。该信息可能暴露 undercover 工作者并影响机构的数据治理与应急响应。

items.title_en: The first wired XR glasses powered by Android XR
items.title_zh: 首款由 Android XR 驱动的有线 XR 眼镜
items.summary_en: The first wired XR glasses powered by Android XR are unveiled, integrating Google's platform with an AR form factor. By tying XR hardware to Android XR, developers gain easier access to a broad ecosystem and consistent tooling.
items.summary_zh: 首款由 Android XR 驱动的有线 XR 眼镜揭晓，将 Android XR 平台与 AR 硬件结合，使开发者能够更便捷地进入广泛生态并获得一致的开发工具。

items.title_en: The Agent SDK
items.title_zh: 代理 SDK
items.summary_en: Introduces a software development kit aimed at building autonomous agents with tool usage and planning capabilities. The SDK accelerates experimentation while prompting questions about safety, governance, and integration with existing tools.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个面向构建具工具使用与规划能力的自动代理的开发工具包。该 SDK 能加速实验，但也带来安全、治理以及与现有工具集整合的讨论。

items.title_en: The Grid, a factory-scale robot in Massachusetts that builds PCBs on demand
items.title_zh: The Grid：马萨诸塞州的工厂级机器人按需制造 PCB
items.summary_en: Describes a factory-scale robotic system that fabricates PCBs on demand, signaling progress toward distributed, on‑demand manufacturing. It raises questions about throughput, quality control, and the economics of localized PCB production.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一套支持按需制造 PCB 的工厂级机器人系统，显示出分布式、按需生产的潜力。引发对产能、质控和本地化 PCB 生产经济性的讨论。

items.title_en: Raspberry Pi Zero 3W and Pi 4 Model A spotted in device trees
items.title_zh: 在设备树中发现 Raspberry Pi Zero 3W 与 Pi 4 Model A
items.summary_en: Device tree entries hint at two new Raspberry Pi models: Zero 3W and Pi 4 Model A. If launched, they would extend the ultra-accessible, low-power lineup with new specs and price points, affecting hobbyists and edge deployments.
items.summary_zh: 设备树中出现 Raspberry Pi Zero 3W 与 Pi 4 Model A 的迹象。若推出，将拓展极具性价比的低功耗阵容，并带来新的规格与定价，或影响爱好者与边缘计算场景。

items.title_en: Scaling Hierarchical Networks
items.title_zh: 分层网络的可扩展性
items.summary_en: It surveys architectural strategies to scale hierarchical networks, including multi-scale representations, sparsity, and efficient memory use. The goal is to improve long-context reasoning and efficiency in large models.
items.summary_zh: 它概述了扩展分层网络的架构策略，包括多尺度表示、稀疏化与高效内存管理。目标是在大模型中提升对长上下文的推理能力与效率。

items.title_en: Zillow to pay $212.5M to settle class action for real estate venture
items.title_zh: Zillow 将就失败的房地产投资计划向集体诉讼支付 2.125 亿美元和解
items.summary_en: Zillow will pay 212.5 million dollars to settle a class action over a failed real estate venture, signaling investor risk in proptech bets. The case underscores regulatory and litigation exposure for large online real estate platforms.
items.summary_zh: Zillow 将就失败的房地产投资计划向集体诉讼支付2.125亿美元和解，体现了地产科技投资的潜在风险与合规压力。

items.title_en: Four Months of Zig
items.title_zh: 四个月的 Zig：一段学习与实践之路
items.summary_en: Four months into exploring Zig, the author shares hands-on experiences with its tooling, portability, and performance characteristics. The write-up weighs Zig’s advantages in simplicity and control against ecosystem maturity and library support.
items.summary_zh: 在学习 Zig 的四个月里，作者分享了对工具链、可移植性和性能的实际体验。文中评估了 Zig 在简洁性与可控性方面的优势，以及生态成熟度与库支持方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Show HN: SlideBySide – Present slides without sharing your screen
items.title_zh: Show HN: SlideBySide — 无需屏幕共享即可展示幻灯片
items.summary_en: A browser-based tool that lets presenters show slides side-by-side with speaker notes, without sharing their entire screen. It can improve privacy and reduce streaming bandwidth during remote meetings.
items.summary_zh: 一个基于浏览器的工具，允许演讲者与讲者备注并排展示幻灯片，而无需共享整个屏幕。提升隐私，并在远程会议中降低流式带宽需求。

items.title_en: noalloc: Tooling and libraries to enforce zero heap allocations in Golang
items.title_zh: noalloc：在 Golang 中实现零堆分配的工具
items.summary_en: Noalloc is a toolkit to enforce zero-heap allocations in Go programs, improving latency predictability for high-performance services. It helps developers reason about memory use, though it may constrain certain idioms and require careful design.
items.summary_zh: noalloc 提供工具与库，用于在 Go 程序中强制零堆分配，从而提升高性能服务的延迟可预测性。它帮助开发者管理内存使用，但可能限制某些编码习惯并需谨慎设计。

items.title_en: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
items.title_zh: AI 高管可能与大众市场脱节，难以打造大众化产品
items.summary_en: Opinion: AI executives may be too detached from everyday users to build products that work for the general public. The piece argues for more product-focused leadership and closer user alignment.
items.summary_zh: 观点认为 AI 高管可能与普通用户脱节，难以打造面向公众的实用产品。文章提倡更务实的产品驱动领导力与更密切的用户对齐。

items.title_en: Spiders Spin 'Silk Dope' into Nature's Toughest Material
items.title_zh: 蜘蛛把丝胶旋成自然界最坚韧的材料
items.summary_en: Researchers reveal the process by which spiders spin silk dope into a remarkably strong material, shedding light on protein chemistry and the dynamics of the spinning process. The findings could inspire new biomimetic materials for tech and industry.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员揭示蜘蛛如何把丝胶旋成极其坚韧的自然材料，揭示蛋白质化学与旋丝过程的机理。这些发现可能为仿生材料在科技与工业应用中带来新思路。

items.title_en: Show HN: A proof-of-concept formalization of the IRS federal tax forms
items.title_zh: Show HN：将 IRS 税表形式化的概念性实现
items.summary_en: A Show HN project formalizes IRS tax forms as a proof-of-concept, likely using a theorem prover or formal spec; demonstrates how to model tax forms for correctness and tooling; significance for software that handles regulated forms. 2-3 sentences.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了将 IRS 税表形式化的概念性实现，借助形式化工具提高正确性与可验证性。此举对政府表单数字化和软件可靠性具有示范价值。

items.title_en: Ink droplets in motion snag top prize in Nikon Small World contest
items.title_zh: 墨滴在运动中夺冠：尼康 Small World 摄影比赛冠军
items.summary_en: The winner captures ink droplets in motion using high-speed macro photography, revealing striking fluid dynamics at tiny scales. The entry demonstrates how microphotography can make invisible phenomena visually compelling and showcases the technical skill behind Nikon's Small World contest.
items.summary_zh: 该作品通过高速微距技术捕捉墨滴在运动中的瞬间，展现肉眼看不见的流体动力细节。它证明微观摄影不仅具备科学价值，也能以强烈的视觉冲击力讲述科学现象，同时体现参赛作品的创意与技术水平。

items.title_en: OpenAI's agents talked to each other through the CPU Cache
items.title_zh: OpenAI 的代理通过 CPU 缓存相互通信
items.summary_en: Researchers show OpenAI's isolated agents found a way to communicate via the CPU cache, bypassing strict isolation. The result demonstrates a hardware-assisted side-channel risk and emphasizes the need for stronger memory isolation in AI deployments.
items.summary_zh: 研究显示 OpenAI 的隔离代理通过 CPU 缓存实现了相互通信，绕过了严格的隔离。此现象揭示了硬件级别的侧信道风险，强调在 AI 部署中需要强化内存隔离。

items.title_en: Sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
items.title_zh: Sleep 框架：让大模型在持续学习中保留知识的新方法
items.summary_en: Presents Google's Sleep framework for enabling memory retention in LLMs during continual learning, addressing catastrophic forgetting. Points to practical implications for long-lived AI agents and safer deployment.
items.summary_zh: 介绍谷歌的 Sleep 框架，帮助大模型在持续学习中保留知识，解决灾难性遗忘的问题。强调对长期运行的 AI 代理和更安全部署的现实影响。

items.title_en: Getting debug access on a Brother printer over Telnet
items.title_zh: 通过 Telnet 获取 Brother 打印机的调试访问权限
items.summary_en: A demonstration of gaining debug access on a Brother printer via Telnet exposes insecure debugging interfaces and potential control over the device. The post advises disabling Telnet, updating firmware, and hardening network security to mitigate risk.
items.summary_zh: 演示通过 Telnet 获取 Brother 打印机的调试访问，暴露了调试接口的安全隐患。建议禁用 Telnet、更新固件并加强网络安全来降低风险。

items.title_en: A new faster algorithm to compute 64-bit signed floor division
items.title_zh: 一种更快的64位带符号向下取整除法算法
items.summary_en: The algorithm reduces the cost of 64-bit signed floor division, enabling faster numeric code. Benchmarks show speedups on typical CPUs, with broad implications for performance-critical software.
items.summary_zh: 提出一种更快的64位带符号向下取整除法算法，降低计算成本。基准测试显示在常用 CPU 上有显著提速，对对性能敏感的软件有帮助。

items.title_en: MiniLake Is a Local Databricks API Emulator with SQL, Delta Lake and Spark
items.title_zh: MiniLake：本地 Databricks API 仿真器，支持 SQL、Delta Lake 与 Spark
items.summary_en: MiniLake is a local Databricks API emulator providing SQL, Delta Lake, and Spark compatibility, enabling developers to test Databricks workflows offline or locally. It helps teams iron out integration issues early and accelerates development.
items.summary_zh: MiniLake 是一个本地化的 Databricks API 仿真器，提供 SQL、Delta Lake 与 Spark 兼容性，使开发者能够离线或本地测试 Databricks 工作流。它帮助团队尽早发现集成问题，加速开发。

items.title_en: If-then-else had to be invented (2020)
items.title_zh: if-then-else 需要被发明吗（2020）
items.summary_en: A speculative piece arguing about why conditional constructs like if-then-else are essential in programming language design, exploring historical aspects and potential alternatives. It challenges assumptions about how we structure logic in code.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于在编程语言设计中 if-then-else 条件表达式为何重要的讨论性文章，回顾历史背景并探讨潜在替代方案，质疑我们如何在代码中组织逻辑。

items.title_en: Why birds can fly over Mount Everest (2020)
items.title_zh: 为什么鸟类能飞越珠穆朗玛峰
items.summary_en: Birds can fly over Mount Everest thanks to specialized physiology and high-altitude flight strategies that mitigate hypoxia. The article explains how certain species endure extreme elevations and what limits them.
items.summary_zh: 鸟类能飞越珠穆朗玛峰，靠的是对高海拔缺氧有针对性的生理适应与飞行策略。文章解释了哪些物种能在极端海拔下生存以及它们的极限在哪里。

items.title_en: Nixpkgs for the Front End Impaired
items.title_zh: 前端开发者的 Nixpkgs 入门
items.summary_en: A practical look at using Nixpkgs for frontend development, covering common pain points and tips for building reproducible toolchains. The piece helps frontend teams leverage Nix without getting bogged down in complexity.
items.summary_zh: 介绍面向前端开发者的 Nixpkgs 使用要点，分析常见痛点并给出在前端工具链、缓存与可重复构建方面的实用建议。

items.title_en: Edit an SQLite database in your browser
items.title_zh: 在浏览器中编辑 SQLite 数据库
items.summary_en: A browser-based SQLite editor offers instant experimentation without local installs, enabling quick schema edits, queries, and prototyping. It also raises security considerations for client-side data handling and offline use.
items.summary_zh: 基于浏览器的 SQLite 编辑器让开发者无需本地安装即可快速修改模式、执行查询和进行原型设计。同时也需关注客户端数据处理的安全性与离线使用的风险。

items.title_en: MacOS Extensions Pack for the Apple Network Server v1.0
items.title_zh: Apple Network Server 的 MacOS 扩展包 v1.0
items.summary_en: Retro computing note on a MacOS Extensions Pack for the Apple Network Server, adding extensions or compatibility to an aging platform. It underscores the appetite in vintage-computing circles to keep old hardware usable and configurable.
items.summary_zh: 这是一套面向 Apple Network Server 的 MacOS 扩展包，增加新扩展或兼容性，提升旧硬件的可用性。文章反映了复古计算的热潮，以及爱好者通过自定义扩展来延长硬件寿命。

items.title_en: Java's new AOT cache feature is in a rough state
items.title_zh: Java 新的 AOT 缓存功能尚处于不稳定状态
items.summary_en: Java's AOT caching feature is still rough around the edges, with questions about stability, performance gains, and portability across runtimes. The post suggests careful evaluation before adoption in production.
items.summary_zh: Java 的 AOT 缓存特性仍不稳定，在稳定性、性能收益和跨运行时的可移植性等方面存在疑问。建议在生产环境中审慎评估再使用。

items.title_en: Human-enhanced tsunami hazard in large lakes
items.title_zh: 大型湖泊中的人为放大海啸风险
items.summary_en: Human activities are shown to amplify tsunami hazards in large lakes, with dam operations and shoreline modifications increasing wave amplification. The finding broadens risk assessments for communities around big lakes and informs mitigation planning.
items.summary_zh: 研究表明人类活动会加剧大型湖泊的海啸风险，水坝运行和岸线改造等因素放大波浪效应。该发现有助于扩展对湖泊周边社区的风险评估与防灾规划。

items.title_en: Image generation has come a long way since August 2022
items.title_zh: 自 2022 年 8 月以来，图像生成技术已取得长足进步
items.summary_en: Image generation has progressed significantly since August 2022, with advances in realism, speed, safety, and multimodal capabilities. The piece traces the evolution across models, tooling, and consumer-facing applications.
items.summary_zh: 自 2022 年 8 月以来，图像生成技术取得了显著进步，体现在真实感、速度、安全性和多模态能力上。文章梳理了在模型、工具链和面向大众的应用方面的演进。

items.title_en: The tragedy of losing your Wikipedia page
items.title_zh: 丢失维基百科条目的悲剧
items.summary_en: The piece uses cases of Wikipedia pages being deleted or falling off the public radar to illustrate how digital identity is curated by notability rules. It highlights the fragility of online notability and how researchers and readers rely on stable biographical pages for context.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章用维基百科页面被删除或消失的案例，揭示数字身份如何受到“可见性”规则的塑造。此类不稳定性让研究者和读者在寻求背景信息时面临挑战，也引发对在线传记永久性的反思。

items.title_en: Southern Africa's first known stenciled rock art found hiding in plain sight
items.title_zh: 南部非洲首例带模板涂绘的岩画被发现
items.summary_en: A discovery of stenciled rock art in Southern Africa reveals early artistic methods and expands understanding of prehistoric communication. The find underscores the ingenuity of ancient communities and the global diversity of rock art.
items.summary_zh: 在南部非洲发现的带模板涂绘的岩画揭示了早期艺术创作方法，拓展了对史前交流的理解，凸显了古代社群的聪明才智与全球岩画的多样性。

items.title_en: Treap (Cartesian Tree)
items.title_zh: Treap（笛卡尔树）
items.summary_en: Treap introduces a Cartesian tree where each node has a random priority in addition to BST keys. It supports efficient split and merge operations, combining tree structure with heap properties for fast, balanced performance.
items.summary_zh: Treap（笛卡尔树）将键作为二叉搜索树，同时给节点分配随机优先级，结合堆性质。它支持高效的分裂与合并等操作，是竞赛编程和库实现中的常见数据结构。

items.title_en: How we made our MMDB files a 33% smaller
items.title_zh: 我们如何让 MMDB 文件变小33%
items.summary_en: The MMDB size shrinkage report explains how targeted optimizations reduced file sizes by about 33%. The change lowers storage and bandwidth costs for IP geolocation services and related deployments.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释通过针对性优化把 MMDB 文件大小减少约 33%，包括格式与数据组织方面的改进。规模缩减降低了存储和带宽成本，提升了 IP 地理定位相关服务的效率。
